title: Watch Together
description: Cross-site video-sync extension shipping on the Chrome Web Store. WebSocket relay with heartbeat drift correction (<0.5s), host-mode enforcement, site-specific player adapters, 59 vitest tests + Puppeteer e2e.

title: Gondilal Saraf
description: Three surfaces (public site + bilingual catalogue + admin ERP) in one Next.js 15 codebase. Image pipeline: Photoroom → Sharp → Gemini 2.0 Flash → Replicate SDXL. 15 Prisma models, 26 API routes, 85 tests.

title: Serenity
description: Rant-first health logging where Claude extracts structured symptoms, medications, and mood from free-form text. Lab-report PDF parser with Zod-validated JSON output and manual fallback form. 15 Prisma models.

title: Red Bull YouTube Sentiment Analytics
description: VADER sentiment on 500 YouTube comments. Net Sentiment Score +28.6 pp (2× industry benchmark), 100% hashtag discipline across a 50-video catalog, 8-chart Excel dashboard + executive-summary PDF.

title: U.S. Power Outages (DSC 80)
description: Analysed 1,534 major U.S. power outages (2000 to 2016). Random Forest with engineered features reached RMSE 6,189 min and R² 0.220, with fairness checks across weather vs. non-weather outages (p ≈ 0.007 on price-tier hypothesis test).

title: MLB Playoff Prediction (COGS 108)
description: Team-of-5 Winter 2026 final project on early-season predictors of MLB playoff qualification 2015 to 2023 via Fangraphs pybaseball. Proposal → EDA → final analysis across four notebooks. I led the ethics section.

title: Circuit (Glass Table Games)
description: Board games with dice you can check. Circuit holds Ludo and Snakes and Ladders.

title: Deal (Glass Table Games)
description: The card games, dealt where anybody can check the deal. Deal holds Judgement, 29, Call Break, Pachisa, 3-2-5, FreeCell, Klondike and Spider.

title: Lattice (Glass Table Games)
description: Lattice is a crossing-words board played at a table or solo against the computer.

title: Upkeep
description: How an Indian home actually works, and what actually worked on it.

title: Fitout
description: What goes into an Indian room, what it costs, and what it commits you to.

title: Larder
description: An Indian kitchen reference where every answer is computed from a registry and checked by the build, not typed twice and left to drift.
